rule_or_question: GVK mukerrer 20/B text and conditions
finding: Statute (as amended by 7491 s. K. md. 7, effective 1/1/2024) exempts earnings of individuals who share text/image/audio/video content over the internet and earnings from individual courses, training, data processing and development, product promotion and similar services provided over these media. Conditions: account at a bank established in Turkey; ALL related revenue collected exclusively through that account; bank withholds 15% on each transfer (final tax if under the limit). Unmet conditions trigger tax plus vergi ziyai cezasi and late interest.
required_action: Do not route any revenue into the account until eligibility is confirmed; keep exclusive-account discipline if used

rule_or_question: 2026 annual limit for 20/B
finding: Limit = amount in the 4th bracket of the GVK md. 103 tariff. 2026 tariff (GV Genel Tebligi Seri No 332, RG 31/12/2025, 33124 5. mukerrer) puts the 4th bracket ceiling at 5,300,000 TL. Previous finding 5,300,000 TL confirmed. If exceeded, the exemption is lost for that year and ALL such income is declared (withholdings credited).
required_action: Track gross receipts per calendar year; plan for annual return if approaching limit

rule_or_question: Istisna belgesi and 1-month bank-account notification
finding: GV Genel Tebligi Seri 318 as amended by Seri 325 (RG 26/09/2024, 32674): obtain istisna belgesi from the tax office (in person, by post or via Dijital Vergi Dairesi); if not yet registered, mukellefiyet is opened first and then the belge is issued (Ornek 10); bank name/branch/IBAN must be notified in writing to the tax office within ONE MONTH of opening the account or presenting the belge to the bank for an existing account.
required_action: Calendar the 1-month notification; keep proof of submission

revenue_or_activity: Google AdSense on a tool site
rule_or_question: Does AdSense income from an own website whose core is interactive browser tools fall under 20/B?
finding: Teblig 325 para. 18 lists advertising income among covered income and Ornek 4 covers ad income on the taxpayer's OWN website that publishes educational videos. A 14/06/2022 ozelge (under the pre-2024 'sosyal ag saglayici' wording) refused the exemption for personal-website click/ad income (recipe site); that wording has since been replaced by 'internet ve benzeri elektronik ortamlar'. No ozelge found that addresses ad income on a utility/tool website after 1/1/2024. Whether interactive tools count as 'shared content' or a 'data processing service' is open.
required_action: Request a written ozelge (VUK md. 413) describing the site exactly (tools + editorial guides + AdSense) before relying on 20/B

rule_or_question: Tax treatment if 20/B does not apply
finding: Pre-2024 ozelge (2020) treated personal-website AdSense payments as ticari kazanc under GVK md. 37: requires mukellefiyet, bookkeeping (isletme defteri), annual return and progressive tariff (15%-40% in 2026).
required_action: Budget for mali musavir fees and progressive tax in the fallback scenario

rule_or_question: KDV exemption
finding: KDV Kanunu md. 17/4-a exempts deliveries and services that are the subject of earnings taxed under GVK mukerrer 20/B (wording amended by 7587 s. K. 24/06/2026 to add gecici 94). Secondary reporting of a Bursa ozelge (02/12/2025) says exceeding the limit does not by itself remove the KDV exemption; not verified against primary text.
required_action: Confirm KDV position for any income stream outside 20/B

rule_or_question: KDV on services to foreign parties
finding: Outside 20/B, services to foreign customers may qualify for KDV md. 11/1-a export exemption only if the benefit is used abroad; Paddle (MoR) also sells to buyers in Turkey, so 'benefit abroad' is not clear-cut. No ozelge found for Paddle reseller structure.
required_action: Ask mali musavir/ozelge on KDV for Paddle payouts before enabling paid features

rule_or_question: Affiliate commissions via own website under 20/B
finding: Ankara Defterdarligi ozelge 14/01/2026 (E-38418978-120[Mük 20-2025/1]-25669): commissions from recommending internet products via YouTube and the requester's own website may benefit from 20/B if all conditions are met. Ozelgeler bind only the requester's own facts. Another ozelge (secondary report) notes link sharing alone does not automatically put income under 20/B.
required_action: Ensure affiliate payouts can be paid into the dedicated TR account; disclose affiliate links on the site

rule_or_question: Sponsorship income under 20/B
finding: Teblig 325 para. 18 lists sponsorship income among covered income for content creators/service providers on the internet. Applicability still depends on LEGAL-04 (is the tool site a 'content' activity). Sponsors that are Turkish companies will need an invoice/receipt and may have their own withholding questions.
required_action: Written sponsorship contract; collect only into dedicated account; label sponsored placements

rule_or_question: Does 20/B cover selling web-app access or software licenses?
finding: Teblig 325 para. 17 and Ornek 19-20: app-developer exemption covers only MOBILE apps sold via app-store platforms; computer applications sold to customers outside such platforms are NOT covered. Subscription income is listed as covered for content creators (para. 18; Bursa ozelge 02/12/2025 on a paid channel). Selling browser-tool features through Paddle looks closer to software sales than content subscriptions; secondary sources say software/license sales are not automatically covered.
required_action: Assume ticari kazanc + normal tax for paid features unless an ozelge says otherwise

revenue_or_activity: donations (GitHub Sponsors / Buy Me a Coffee)
rule_or_question: Donations/tips under 20/B
finding: Teblig 325 para. 18 lists bagislar, hediyeler, bahsisler among covered income (Ornek 21: donation button on social account). Same scope caveat as LEGAL-04. Donations to an individual for his own work are taxable income, not gifts free of tax.
required_action: Route payouts to dedicated account; do not describe as charity

rule_or_question: Does 20/B mukellefiyet trigger Bag-Kur (SGK 4/b)?
finding: No SGK genelge found. 5510 md. 4/1-b covers income-tax payers on ticari/serbest meslek kazanci; 20/B is an 'istisna' (exemption) with mukellefiyet opened (Teblig Ornek 10), so 4/b registration and monthly premiums are likely unless an md. 6 exception applies (e.g., already 4/a or 4/c insured, under 18, pensioner). A tax inspector's column (06/09/2025) reads it this way; a petition text reports automatic 4/b starts. Bag-Kur premiums can exceed early ad income.
required_action: Ask SGK/mali musavir before applying; check whether existing 4/a employment covers you

rule_or_question: Genc girisimci istisnasi (GVK mukerrer 20) as fallback
finding: First-time ticari/zirai/mesleki mukellefiyet, under 29 at start date, full-liability individual: 3 tax years exempt up to the 2nd bracket amount (2026: 400,000 TL); conditions include timely ise baslama notice, running the business personally, not taking over a relative's business; annual return still required. Exemption is income-tax only (not KDV). Interaction with 20/B for same income is disputed in secondary sources.
required_action: Check age eligibility and first-time-mukellefiyet status before choosing this route

rule_or_question: Stripe availability for Turkish residents
finding: Turkey is not in Stripe's list of supported countries (stripe.com/global retrieved 2026-11-27).
required_action: Do not plan on direct Stripe accounts

rule_or_question: Lemon Squeezy shutdown
finding: Lemon Squeezy site banner: shutting down on 31 March 2027 and no longer accepting new sign-ups. Successor Stripe Managed Payments supports merchants in about 35+ countries; Turkey support not shown.
required_action: Exclude Lemon Squeezy from options

rule_or_question: Can a Turkish individual onboard as a Paddle seller?
finding: Paddle works with software businesses worldwide except a listed set of unsupported countries; Turkey is NOT on that list. Account verification: business verification is not required for individuals or sole traders (identity check instead). Payout methods/currency to Turkish banks and whether a TR tax registration is required were not confirmed. Paddle buys and resells as MoR, so customer-facing VAT/sales tax is Paddle's.
required_action: Confirm with Paddle support: individual onboarding from TR, payout to TR bank in USD/EUR, required tax ID

rule_or_question: GitHub Sponsors availability
finding: GitHub docs list Turkey among supported regions in which a sponsored developer must reside to receive funds; personal-account sponsorships carry no GitHub fee.
required_action: Check payout bank details can point to the dedicated 20/B account if used

rule_or_question: Buy Me a Coffee payouts for Turkey
finding: BMC pays out via Stripe Express in Stripe countries and a 'Standard Payout' (Payoneer/bank) elsewhere; no official confirmation that Turkey is supported. Stripe does not support Turkey.
required_action: Verify in BMC payout settings before linking from site

rule_or_question: Foreign currency in 20/B account and withholding base
finding: Teblig 318/325: for FX deposits the 15% withholding base is calculated at the transfer-date buying rate (secondary summary of teblig md. 5); FX receipts into the dedicated account are permitted (Bursa ozelge 02/12/2025, secondary).
required_action: Prefer an FX account at the same TR bank designated under 20/B

rule_or_question: Mandatory FX conversion (Ihracat Bedelleri / Gorunmeyen Islemler Genelgesi)
finding: Exporters must sell 35% of export proceeds to TCMB via banks, extended to 31/01/2027 (news reports). No source found that applies this to an individual's AdSense/Paddle receipts; service-income treatment in 2026 not confirmed.
required_action: Ask the receiving bank how it classifies incoming Google/Paddle transfers

rule_or_question: KVKK aydinlatma and cookie consent
finding: KVKK (6698) md. 10 requires an aydinlatma metni; KVKK cookie guidance expects consent for non-essential (ad/analytics) cookies. Site already processes visitor data via ad/analytics scripts even without accounts.
required_action: Publish/verify aydinlatma + cerez politikasi in Turkish; no non-essential cookie before consent

rule_or_question: VERBIS registration
finding: Kurul Karari 2025/1572 (04/09/2025; RG 01/10/2025): controllers with fewer than 50 employees and annual balance sheet below 100 million TL are exempt unless main activity is special-category data (stricter 10 employees / 10 million TL test); 2025/2393 clarified balance-sheet criterion. A solo individual operator appears exempt.
required_action: Re-check exemption if staff or turnover changes

rule_or_question: KVKK md. 9 cross-border transfer
finding: Law 7499 (in force 01/06/2024) rewrote md. 9: transfers abroad need adequacy, appropriate safeguards (e.g., standard contract notified to KVKK within 5 business days) or limited exceptions. How a solo publisher's use of Google AdSense and Vercel Speed Insights fits (Google terms vs. KVKK standard contract) is not settled.
required_action: Ask a KVKK-savvy lawyer; document vendors and transfer basis

rule_or_question: GDPR Art. 3(2)(b) and Google CMP requirement
finding: GDPR applies to non-EU controllers monitoring EU users' behaviour (ad personalisation via cookies). Google requires a Google-certified CMP integrated with IAB TCF for personalised ads in EEA/UK (since 16/01/2024) and Switzerland (since 31/07/2024); otherwise only non-personalised/limited ads. Google Ad Manager docs: TCF v2.3 mandatory for TC strings from 28/02/2026.
required_action: Use a Google-certified CMP on TCF v2.3 (or Google's own Privacy & messaging); consider EU representative question (Art. 27)

rule_or_question: Cayma hakki for instantly delivered digital content
finding: Mesafeli Sozlesmeler Yonetmeligi md. 15/1-g: no withdrawal right for services performed instantly online or intangible goods delivered instantly; md. 5/1-h requires pre-contract information that the consumer has no withdrawal right. If Paddle is MoR, Paddle is the seller to the consumer; obligations then sit largely with Paddle.
required_action: Show the no-withdrawal notice at checkout if selling directly; review Paddle buyer terms

rule_or_question: 6563 hizmet saglayici info duties and ETBIS registration
finding: 6563 requires service providers to give identity/contact information; ETBIS registration applies to e-commerce service providers selling goods/services. Whether an ad-funded free tool site or a Paddle-MoR setup requires ETBIS registration was not confirmed.
required_action: Ask mali musavir whether ETBIS is needed once a mukellefiyet exists

rule_or_question: pdf-lib MIT, jszip dual MIT/GPLv3, pdfjs-dist Apache-2.0
finding: JSZip LICENSE: dual licensed, user may choose MIT or GPLv3 (choose MIT). pdf-lib, decimal.js, zod, undici are MIT; pdfjs-dist and @vercel/speed-insights are Apache-2.0 (keep license and NOTICE text). Commercial use is permitted under these licences; obligation is attribution/notice retention in distributed bundles.
required_action: Ship a third-party licences page or keep license comments in built bundles

rule_or_question: Ozelge as the way to resolve scope questions
finding: VUK md. 413 allows taxpayers to request a written ozelge on their own facts; it binds the administration only for the requester and those facts.
required_action: File an ozelge request covering AdSense, affiliate, sponsorship, donations and Paddle sales
